description: Hyperliquid perpetuals market snapshot — every active coin (~180) with mark and oracle price, premium in bps, funding rate (8h + annualised APR) and which side collects it, open interest in USD, 24h notional volume, 24h change, and max leverage. Filter with ?coins=BTC,ETH, sort with ?sort=volume|funding|oi|change|name, cap with ?limit=1-300. Includes the top-5 funding extremes and chain-wide OI/volume totals. Live from Hyperliquid /info, cached 30s. Use for funding-harvest sc
